# اُسْتُكْرِيَا (ustukriyā) /us.tuk.ri.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
# اِسْتَكْرِيَا (istakriyā) /is.tak.ri.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
